tool_args.prompt: Create ONE complete transparent-background game character image of the normal cloth-hood Executioner Majini from Resident Evil 5 (2009), grounded in the attached original-edition complete-body reference. The image must show a NEW physically rotated RIGHT-FACING side-dominant three-quarter neutral ready stance: hood direction, shoulders, torso and weapon action all clearly aim toward SCREEN RIGHT, with a narrowed torso projection. Keep the bowed pointed dark burlap hood with its nails and protruding metal pins, huge muscular gray-purple torso, dark leather straps, wrapped forearms, long heavy ragged apron, and complete source axe with its wooden shaft, rusted rectangular upper head, metal chains and long serrated lower blade. Preserve the source material appearance, proportions and asymmetric equipment; this is the normal cloth-hood variant. Hold the shaft with both anatomically correct hands in front of the body, the axe head extending toward screen right. The complete axe head, every serration, shaft butt, hook and pin must fit INSIDE the canvas. Maintain the original apron occlusion: one boot is visible beneath the apron and the other leg remains naturally hidden, without inventing a newly exposed boot surface. Frame the entire single character and entire weapon together with at least 8 percent completely transparent breathing room on ALL sides; make the subject smaller to fit instead of cropping any extremity. Grounded original-game textured survival-horror rendering with clean real alpha, not a cartoon or a glossy modern redesign. Preserve only the wear already present in the source without intensifying injury or adding gore. No software mirror, second figure, extra limbs, montage, floor, cast shadow backdrop, environment, typography, logo, glow or border. A single static generated adaptation for visual review, not an original game frame or a certified animation.
